title: IncidentEnvelope
description: Raw envelope published by the gateway right after authentication, before any interpretation — one per received event, append-only. The payload is opaque; everything outside it is the minimum needed to authenticate, partition, and reprocess. Consumed by the translation stage, never by a business consumer. See domain/acl/itsm.md and docs/insights/fluxo-do-incidente.md.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier (UUID v4), assigned by the gateway.

source.description: Origin adapter identifier, assigned by the gateway from the route and the integration's credential — never declared by the payload.

intake.description: Nature of the origin, assigned by the gateway from the route that received the event. See domain/ubiquitous-language.md#intake.

received_at.description: Timestamp when the gateway received the event (UTC, ISO 8601), assigned by the gateway.

payload.description: The origin's body, verbatim, as a JSON string. Opaque at this stage — no field inside it is typed here.
